description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8}{R}{R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Orthion and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
